---
title: "Brands"
subtitle: "Every brand on an MLS front of kit, sleeve or stadium, its footprint across the league, and how much public attention it gets"
description: "A directory of MLS sponsor brands with their clubs, assets and Wikipedia attention."
---

```{python}
#| include: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import charts
from charts import raw_html

b = charts.query("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS brands,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clubs > 1) AS multi,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE avg_daily_views_28d IS NOT NULL) AS tracked,
           COUNT(DISTINCT parent_company) AS parents
    FROM mart_brand_portfolio
""").iloc[0]
multi = charts.query("""
    SELECT brand_name, clubs, club_list FROM mart_brand_portfolio
    WHERE clubs > 1 ORDER BY clubs DESC, brand_name
""")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.kpi_row([
    (f"{int(b.brands)}", "Sponsor brands", "with a current tracked deal"),
    (f"{int(b.multi)}", "Multi-club brands", "hold assets at 2+ clubs"),
    (f"{int(b.tracked)}", "With attention data", "confirmed Wikipedia article"),
])))
names = "; ".join(f"**{r.brand_name}** ({r.club_list})" for r in multi.itertuples())
print(f"Most MLS sponsorship is local: a brand buys into one club's market. "
      f"Only {int(b.multi)} brands hold assets at more than one club: {names}.\n")
```

## Brand directory

Search by brand, owner, category or club. *Views/day* is the brand's average
daily Wikipedia pageviews over the last 28 days: its public attention overall,
not attention it gets from MLS.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.brand_directory() or "<p>No brands yet.</p>"))
```
